products.description: India's largest Indic-language social media platform for sharing content including entertainment, news, sports, devotion, humour across 15+ regional languages. Features chatrooms, live streaming, virtual gifting, WhatsApp status sharing.

products.name: Moj
products.description: India's #1 short-video app for creating and watching short videos, reels, and short dramas. Launched in July 2020 in response to TikTok ban. Features Moj+ premium originals.

products.name: QuickTV
products.description: Subscription-only micro-drama platform launched May 2025. Short episodic content in multiple languages. Crossed 15Mn downloads within 4 months; 7.3Mn subscribers; 90+ mins avg daily time spent; 700+ micro-drama series.
